exposure: Three approaches to facilitating simulation-based, peer-assisted learning for prevention and management of postpartum hemorrhage and birth asphyxia
outcome: proportion of births with uterotonic given within one minute of birth
observed care of mother and newborn
simulated skills maintenance for postpartum hemorrhage prophylaxis
simulated skills for newborn bag-and-mask ventilation
cohort: Healthcare providers in 44 facilities across 12 Ugandan districts, with outcomes observed during 1,716 births.
finding: Simulation-based, peer-assisted learning interventions in all groups led to increased uterotonic coverage, improved observed care for mothers and newborns, and reduced the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage, retained placenta, fresh stillbirths, and newborn deaths.
followup_time: 7 to 9 months after intervention completion for various outcomes.
